scripts.dev: npm run build -w @daifugo/core && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project daifugo-dev "concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green 'npm run dev -w @daifugo/server' 'npm run dev -w @daifugo/client'"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @daifugo/core && npm run build -w @daifugo/server && npm run build -w @daifugo/client
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project daifugo-emulator-test "npm run test -w @daifugo/server"
